label: C5 and its negation: completing the same-source ten-slot root and the essentiality gap (#1864)
summary: C5 continuation (2026-11-23) of attempt 8ae3a9d2 (#1880 scope), in TruthCore/Modal/DivineProfile.lean. candidate_greatness_from_ten_and_four isolates the three missing actual omniscient/moral/free selected senses and the four M-successor conditions (one, omniscient, morallyPerfect, free) required to complete the existing SAME-source ten-attribute root. It uses the explicitly fixed GOD-free profile, NecessaryAt of the root and its nine world-free predicate slots (rigid only by construction), and concludes that the same n with PositiveCoreAt (the selected unique root at w) is maximally great at w. Reading choice: free is NoncoercedChoiceAt, a choice actually made, so requiring it at every M-successor takes the 'necessarily exercised' branch of the open freedom test, not 'essentially available'. candidate_possible_from_same_root composes that result with the previously verified ten-slot root and actual reflexivity, returning M-possible greatness and the pinned bearer; it is conditional, not an M-admissibility proof or new GOD_4 edge. In this route C5 is downstream of actual greatness and cannot serve as an independent possibility premise for #437's inference to actual existence (cf. actual_necessary_bundle_greatness). Control.actualButNotEssential, on the generic ProfileSlots whose slot names are mnemonic only, shows that S5, a rigid necessary bearer and actual satisfaction of all thirteen opaque slots do not imply necessary excellence when the opaque one slot (there v = false; not fixedProfile's ActualRoot uniqueness) fails at a successor. 'Essential' means de re modal possession of the slots at every M-successor, not a Finean essence (cf. NecessaryExcellenceAt). Whether the fixedProfile root premises entail one at M-successors is untested. Negative test: #555's same-necessarily-performed-act + strict effect sufficiency + contingent effect core (rigid_core) is inconsistent, but those two act bridges are not established by the divine profile. The nearest registered bridge is SIMPLICITY-ROOT-EXPOSURE (rootExposure, argument df2b23c7): IsImmutable plus the IX.6 potency reading plus the open ModalCapacity collapse the respects (clause 1), and with a decree as respect, ExclusiveDecree, a decree at every accessible world and RespectSuffices give not ContingentAt (clause 2). The C5 encoding's world-free InPotency and q.InAct map to RootExposure's world-indexed ones by constant families. Under the constant family, decree-as-respect plus RespectSuffices alone collapse contingency (Interpreted.constant_respect_collapses_contingency, unregistered): a decree that is a respect holds at every world, so RespectSuffices puts the effect at every accessible world, with no ModalCapacity, IX.6 reading, immutability, ExclusiveDecree or decree-at-each-world. The C5 encoding can host a contingent effect only if creative decrees are not InAct-respects of the source (RootExposure's oneRespect exit) or RespectSuffices fails; a world-varying decree-as-respect would need InAct re-indexed by world, which is the contested point. The world-free q.InAct is rigid by construction, an encoding artifact like fixedProfile_rigid, and evidence for neither side. Comparative C5/not-C5 assessment and revision tests recorded in docs/modal-ontology-120.md. An independent semantic challenge of d8cc4061 returned mergeable after listed repairs (two P1, eight P2), all repaired in PR #1890; the targeted re-check of 12ba81cf confirmed them and raised N1 (P1, the constant-family mapping reversed) and N2 (P2, 40a97664 is a statement), both fixed; no registered canonical argument/result or frontier change.
blocker: C5 and not-C5 metaphysical actuality are both unresolved. C5: conditional one-root ten-slot support; three actual full attributes (intentional omniscience, moral perfection, freely intentional willing), four cross-M selected slots (including whether the fixedProfile root premises entail one at M-successors) and warrant for the nine stipulated world-free predicates remain open. M's metaphysical interpretation, genuine E to M targeted admission, actualist/counterpart identity, GOD_4 name/senses, DEF records also open. Not-C5: the genuine contradictory core #555 requires a defended bridge from simplicity/free creation to one necessarily performed strictly efficacious creative act of a particular contingent effect. For the C5 source, with its world-free q.InAct, the live inputs are only decree-as-respect (a creative decree as an InAct-respect of the source) and RespectSuffices, which together already collapse contingency; neither is established. ModalCapacity, ExclusiveDecree and decree-at-each-world are open inputs only of the general, world-indexed SIMPLICITY-ROOT-EXPOSURE, and re-indexing InAct by world is itself the contested point. Next tests detailed in docs/modal-ontology-120.md.

current_assessment.assessment: Previously reviewed and merged #1880 (attempt 8ae3a9d2) supplies a single necessary actual source with ten interpreted candidate slots, conditional on its entire existing source and task-power/act-potency premises. The C5 composition makes the exact rest explicit: actual omniscience/moral perfection/free selection, four cross-world one/knowledge/moral/freedom conditions (freedom read as a choice exercised at every successor), and an antecedent equality to the GOD-free fixedProfile whose other nine predicates are world-invariant by construction, not argued essential. Actual reflexivity then gives formal M-possible greatness, and the same selected root is pinned as the maximally great bearer at actuality; this is not warranted genuine metaphysical admissibility, and since it is downstream of actual greatness it is no independent possibility premise for #437. A finite S5 control on the generic slot schema, with one necessarily existing bearer satisfying all thirteen opaque slots at actuality but not the opaque one slot at a successor, shows that actuality plus existence-necessity does not entail de re modal possession of the profile; whether fixedProfile's root premises entail one across M is untested. The best negative pressure is #555's strict same-act efficacy contradiction with contingent effects, For the C5 source, whose world-free q.InAct is rigid by construction (an encoding artifact, evidence for neither side), decree-as-respect plus RespectSuffices alone collapse contingency, so those two are the live not-C5 inputs; the C5 encoding hosts a contingent effect only if decrees are not InAct-respects of the source or RespectSuffices fails. ModalCapacity, ExclusiveDecree and decree-at-each-world belong only to the general, world-indexed SIMPLICITY-ROOT-EXPOSURE. No canonical GOD_4 edge, full classical divine possibility, or philosophical C5/not-C5 establishment follows.
current_assessment.next_test: For the C5 source test the two live not-C5 inputs, decree-as-respect (whether a creative decree is an InAct-respect of the source) and RespectSuffices, and whether re-indexing InAct by world is warranted; keep ModalCapacity, ExclusiveDecree and decree-at-each-world for the general world-indexed RootExposure; test whether the fixedProfile root premises entail one at M-successors; pursue #1866/#1873 intrinsic intentional uptake and universal knowledge and whether identity of one intellectual act implies identical known-content membership; #1737/#555 nonnecessitating free decree; then warrant metaphysical M-access, identity, the actual GOD_4 bridge and DEF records before canonical binding.
